opening.argument: The video frames the Terra Luna staking pitch as a cautionary story, not an invitation to invest. One character says investing is “too dangerous,” and the narration rejects easy wealth in favor of risk management. Against those warnings, the characters' claims that staking is safe, offers up to 20% interest, and is a zero-risk option read as reckless persuasion. The story then shows a distressed character, while the title identifies the outcome as a rug pull. The promised return is part of the warning, not a recommendation to viewers.

citations.quote: I get up to 20% interest rate.
There are no magic paths to wealth guys. It's a matter of risk management.
